title: Photovoltaic Power System Equipment and Components

onscreen_lines.desc: Section II: Installation and Repair Service Hourly Labor Rate for Standard Hours for Installation/Repair Service of Photovoltaic Power System Equipment, Components and Related Items - Not to exceed Standard hourly labor rate for Installation/Repair Service of Equipment and Products.
onscreen_lines.note: PROPOSAL NOTE 3: Labor Rate and Hours of Work (Repair and Installation Services Based on Hourly Rate and/or Coefficient To Be Applied To Unite Price Book For installation and repair services of HVAC Equipment and Products, the proposal specifications allow Vendors to propose either a not-to-exceed hourly labor rate and/or a coefficient labor rate to be applied to the Gordian RSMeans unit price book. To the extent a Vendor proposes based on a coefficient to be applied to the unit price book, Vendor must submit a coefficient for both Standard Hours and Non-Standard Hours. Whether proposing installation and/or repair services based on an hourly rate and/or coefficient, Vendors are expected to pursue the contracted tasks during the hours of 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Friday (“Standard Hours”). Hours other than Standard Hours shall be considered non-standard hours (“Non-Standard Hours”). Non-Standard Hour rates are permissible only where work during Non-Standard Hours is either specifically requested or approved in writing by the Cooperative member. If a vendor elects to perform services during Non-Standard Hours, at its own option for Vendor’s own convenience when neither requested nor required by the Cooperative member, Vendor must perform such work at Standard Hours rates and satisfy the following requirements: Vendor submits a request to the Cooperative member in writing at least two working days in advance stating the specific times of the Non-Standard Hours during which the Vendor wishes to perform work; There is no additional cost to the Cooperative member; An authorized representative of the Cooperative member approves the request in advance in writing; and Vendor agrees to any special conditions imposed by the Cooperative member as set forth in the approval document.
